title: MATRIX_LR increase at DEPTH=10
description: Changed MATRIX_LR from 0.04 to 0.06 at DEPTH=10 (new baseline), all else unchanged.
reflection: val_bpb 1.005574, worse than the DEPTH=10 baseline (1.002530) and worse than round-0's DEPTH=8/MATRIX_LR=0.06 result (1.012971 vs 1.014027 baseline there was a small win, but the effect doesn't transfer to depth=10 - the two wins don't stack, they interact negatively. This suggests MATRIX_LR=0.04 is already close to correct for the wider DEPTH=10 model, or that the wider model is more sensitive to a higher Muon LR. Recommend not pursuing MATRIX_LR increases further at DEPTH=10; if anything try lowering it slightly (0.03) in a future round, though I'd deprioritize this axis in favor of a0's DEPTH=11 bracket or an untouched axis.
